SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.noAccount: Don't have an account? Ask your administrator or the business you work with.

ForgotPassword.requestDescription: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a code.
ForgotPassword.checkEmailDescription: If an account exists for <highlight>{email}</highlight>, we sent it a {length}-digit code.
ForgotPassword.success: Password reset. Sign in with your new password.
ForgotPassword.invitedDescription: You've been invited. Confirm your email and we'll send you a code to set your password.

TwoFactor.totpDescription: Enter the {length}-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.trustDevice: Trust this device for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

Invitation.title: You've been invited
Invitation.description: Work together on the business's properties, customers, contracts and payments.
Invitation.expiresIn: This invitation expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
Invitation.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {current}, but this invitation is for {invited}.

invalid.title: This invitation isn't valid
invalid.description: The link may be incomplete or mistyped. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Ask {inviter} to send you a new one.

rejected.title: You declined this invitation
rejected.description: Changed your mind? Ask {inviter} to invite you again.

canceled.title: This invitation was canceled
canceled.description: Ask {inviter} whether you should still join {organization}.

accepted.title: You've already joined
accepted.description: This invitation was accepted. Sign in to work on {organization}.
